notes: The repo's %check_normality macro, unchanged: discovers numeric columns via PROC CONTENTS + PROC SQL INTO :numvars, then runs PROC UNIVARIATE (Shapiro-Wilk / KS / Anderson-Darling) across them, capturing TestsForNormality via ODS OUTPUT. Original read a SAS-Studio-uploaded NAFLD_imputed.csv via FILENAME REFFILE and called the %web_drop_table/%web_open_table session helpers. Replaced with inline DATALINES sampling 6 numeric columns (Age, BMI, AST, ALT, Glucose, Fibrosis) for 25 patients from this repo's own NAFLD_imputed.csv, so the macro's dynamic column-discovery path is exercised for real.
